Title: Diagnosis
Details: The issue report describes a problem where JXPathContext.iteratePointers() does not handle XML elements that share the same namespace URI but have different prefixes correctly. Specifically, when there are multiple prefixes for the same namespace, iteration over pointers returns the first element twice and omits the second.

From the gathered code snippets:
- The abstract method JXPathContext.iteratePointers(String xpath) is implemented in JXPathContextReferenceImpl.
- JXPathContextReferenceImpl.iteratePointers(String xpath) compiles the XPath expression and then delegates to iteratePointers(String, Expression).
- The latter calls Expression.iteratePointers(EvalContext).
- Expression.iteratePointers(EvalContext) calls compute(EvalContext) and processes the result to produce an iterator of pointers.
- The compute method is abstract and likely implemented in subclasses that handle evaluation and namespace resolution.
- The test that fails is testIterateJDOM(), which calls doTestIterate with a JDOM model.

The root cause is likely in the namespace handling in the evaluation of the XPath such that when two prefixes map to the same namespace URI, the iteration over elements is confused and returns duplicate nodes corresponding to the first prefix while omitting nodes with the second prefix. The problem most likely lies in the namespace aliasing or matching logic used during pointer iteration where the prefix is strictly matched or misused rather than matching by namespace URI. This causes iteration to miss elements of the second prefix but identical namespace URI.

Therefore, the bug occurs because the expression evaluation or node pointer retrieval uses prefix-based matching instead of namespace URI-based matching, resulting in duplicated and missing elements during iteration when multiple prefixes share the same namespace URI. The returned iterator in Expression.iteratePointers reflects the wrong set of node pointers due to this incorrect namespace handling.

The test fails due to the above namespace handling inconsistency during pointer iteration with aliased namespace prefixes in JXPathContext.iteratePointers.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
